name: National People's Congress
notes: 2,977 deputies of the 14th NPC, whose qualifications the Standing Committee confirmed on 24 February 2023. No count by party has been published in the reports found (the official report gives only 969 deputies, 32.55%, as Party and government officials, which is not a count of Party members), so the chamber is shown as one block. China has one governing party and eight others that take part in the NPC. No member is named here.
